Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
Foundation
Action

+1 stealth action
Requires a laibon vampire
Put this card in play. If the acting laibon vampire is a magaji untap him or her if this action is successful. All Laibon vampires are considered as having one additional Aye and one Orun. Any titled vampire can burn this card as a D action.

Compelling game need: Aye and Orun decks are choked on masters. The mechanic can be interesting, but dedicating 8+ cards to make the Aye and Orun cards do anything is very discouraging. They also tend to lend themselves to star vampire decks because it is unrealistic to have more than 1 vampire with 3+ Aye or Orun. That limits the Aye or Orun mechanic and makes for Pentex bait.

Game reference: none

Be careful when you fight the monsters, lest you become one.
-Friedrich Nietzsche

Messages.Author: brettscho
Messages.Body:
Well, I've never played with Laibon, so I don't really understand either mechanic, but what if you just had an action like Epiphany that allowed you to search through your deck for an Aye or Orun card and put it on the acting minion (followed by an untap). You could even include the option of taking one of these cards from hand and/or ash heap. This way, you would still need to have plenty of Aye and Orun in your deck (which is a downside all by itself), but now you have a way to thin your deck while also getting your Aye / Orun set up.

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
The problem with orun/aye is they just suck.

In vtm, they act more as a bolt-on humanity-like score. Not a 9-card hat that is USELESS without brutal influence.

If orun/aye were treated right, it wouldve been like humanitas/archetypes/whatever. They take up deck space for nominally weak extras.

Fishing up a billion helps brutal influence. I can assume Darby is giggling at the idea of something that sets up bleeds of a billion and governs for 12. Burn clause is less than meaningful on that card.

Now, "treat this as A/O for everyone" sounds cool, im just unsure its worth making at this point. Again, because orun/aye take stupid amounts of setup for limited gain.
